summary: POST-certified patrol officer with over a decade of continuous law-enforcement experience in mid-market communities. Skilled in emergency response, criminal investigation, and community-oriented policing with a record of accurate reporting and safe suspect apprehension.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
experience.employer: a growing mid-market municipal police department
bullets: Patrol assigned sectors to detect law violators, issue citations, and make arrests while maintaining order and protecting people and property.
Respond to emergency calls including accidents, disturbances, and crimes in progress; render first aid to accident survivors and others requiring immediate physical care.
Investigate suspicious activities and illegal conduct, identify and pursue suspects, and arrest perpetrators of criminal acts.
Verify that proper legal charges are made against law offenders through careful review of incident facts and statute applicability.
Record facts and prepare detailed incident and activity reports that document observations, evidence, and actions taken.
Promote good community relations through regular neighborhood contacts, school visits, and participation in community safety meetings.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
experience.employer: a regional law-enforcement agency serving mid-sized communities
bullets: Conducted routine and directed patrols by vehicle and on foot to deter crime and identify law violators.
Responded to emergency calls for service, secured crime scenes, and assisted accident survivors with first aid until medical personnel arrived.
Reviewed facts of incidents to determine whether criminal acts or statute violations were involved and documented findings in official reports.
Identified, pursued, and arrested suspects while using de-escalation and active listening to resolve tense encounters safely.
Issued citations for motor vehicle and criminal law violations and verified legal charges with supervisors and prosecutors.

experience.title: Police Officer (Patrol)
bullets: Patrolled specific areas to detect law violators, maintain public safety, and respond to calls for service.
Rendered aid to accident survivors and persons requiring first aid for physical injuries prior to EMS arrival.
Recorded facts and prepared reports documenting incidents, activities, and enforcement actions.
Investigated illegal or suspicious activities and supported follow-up inquiries with detailed observations.
Engaged with residents and local businesses to strengthen community relations and encourage crime reporting.

education.degree: POST law-enforcement certification; Associate of Science in Criminal Justice
education.institution: a regional community college and state POST academy
